introHtml: The 3/4-inch width offers a slim, comfortable fit that works well for both headbands and wristbands. Decorate with screen printing or debossing for a clean, professional look that stays visible even on narrow fabric. Perfect for safety teams, event staff, or promotional giveaways where a subtle yet durable band is needed.
